description: The proposed development involves creating a 1st floor level within the roof space of our existing premises. This new floor will link into existing first floor studios at the front of the building. 6nr new studio units will be created on the west facing elelvation The works will comprise, new roof with shallower pitch to the west facing section, retaining the existing steel trusses, and the existing roof structure to the eastern facing section adjoining our nieghbours unit. Double glazed aluminium facade with outside balcony space included facing onto our private side road elevation Each studio fitted with sink / kitchenette unit, wifi connection, video entry, smart electricty meter An external DDA compliant platform will be lift installed. Planters to entrance and 1st floor lift platform
